editorial:
Set in 1949 Los Angeles, this crime thriller throws you into a city run by mob boss Mickey Cohen, who controls drugs, guns, and dirty cops. When a small LAPD crew goes off the books, they start hitting his operations hard. Josh Brolin and Ryan Gosling lead the team, and the movie feels like a loud, stylish gangster story with big fights, sharp suits, and plenty of attitude. It is not subtle, but it moves fast and keeps you entertained.

The action is flashy, the cast is strong, and Sean Penn goes big as Cohen. Some scenes feel cartoonish, and the story can be simple, but the energy rarely drops. If you want a serious mob drama, look elsewhere; if you want a fun, violent throwback, this works. Watch it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Cohen’s men attack O’Mara’s home, but the squad fights back and pushes Cohen into a last stand at his hotel. O’Mara and Cohen have a brutal fistfight, and the police finally arrest Cohen instead of looking away. Cohen is sent to prison, his empire falls, and Grace is free to leave him. Wooters survives, and O’Mara goes home to his family, ending the secret war.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stylish gangster action and big ensemble casts.
